tagline.en: Alibaba DAMO Academy's controllable image-to-video model — drive a clip with camera trajectories, and optionally human motion, on top of a Wan2.1 backbone.
tagline.zh: 阿里达摩院的可控图生视频模型——在 Wan2.1 骨干之上,用相机轨迹、并可选叠加人体动作来驱动视频生成。

en: Uni3C is a controllable video generation model from Alibaba DAMO Academy. Starting from an image, it renders a video that follows a specified camera path, and in its unified mode it can also be driven by human body and hand motion.

It builds on a Wan2.1 image-to-video 14B backbone and a RealisDance-DiT component, offering two paths: a camera-only mode and a unified camera-plus-human mode. Camera mode takes pre-rendered control inputs — a render video, a render mask, and camera info — while unified mode additionally uses SMPL body and hand render videos so the subject's motion tracks your control signal.

In WorldFoundry, you provide the source image and the matching control bundle for the mode you want; the control renders stay explicit inputs rather than being generated for you, so you keep precise control over camera and motion.
zh: Uni3C 是阿里达摩院推出的可控视频生成模型。它从一张图像出发,生成一段沿指定相机路径运动的视频;在统一模式下,还能由人体与手部动作共同驱动。
它基于 Wan2.1 图生视频 14B 骨干与 RealisDance-DiT 组件,提供两条路径:仅相机模式与相机加人体的统一模式。相机模式需要预渲染的控制输入——渲染视频、渲染遮罩与相机信息;统一模式则额外使用 SMPL 人体与手部渲染视频,使主体动作跟随你的控制信号。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你按所选模式提供源图像和对应的控制包;这些控制渲染是显式输入而非自动生成,因此你能对相机与动作保持精确掌控。

whenToUse.en: Reach for Uni3C when you want image-to-video with precise camera control, or when you also need to steer a subject's body and hand motion in the generated clip.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要带精确相机控制的图生视频,或需要在生成片段中进一步操控主体的人体与手部动作时,适合使用 Uni3C。

notFor.en: It expects pre-rendered control bundles as input rather than producing camera or motion for you, so it is less suited to quick text-only generation without prepared control assets.
notFor.zh: 它需要预渲染的控制包作为输入,而不会替你生成相机或动作,因此不太适合没有准备好控制素材、只凭文字快速生成的场景。

en: Camera-controlled image-to-video, with an optional unified human-motion mode
Built on a Wan2.1 image-to-video 14B backbone plus RealisDance-DiT
Camera mode uses render video, render mask, and camera info
Unified mode adds SMPL body and hand render videos
zh: 相机可控的图生视频,并可选人体动作的统一模式
基于 Wan2.1 图生视频 14B 骨干与 RealisDance-DiT
相机模式使用渲染视频、渲染遮罩与相机信息
统一模式额外加入 SMPL 人体与手部渲染视频
